verdict.rationale: Bruno's own pre-request and post-response JavaScript scripts run automatically around request execution at the request, folder or collection level, which is a narrow kind of event-triggered action. AI can also generate these scripts. There is no general rules engine, event trigger system or scheduled automation; CI/CD runs depend on the host pipeline and are not credited. Missing for 10: a declarative rule/trigger system, events beyond the request lifecycle (schedules, external events, file changes), and independent corroboration.
